title: Weighted Chernoff information and optimal loss exponent in context-sensitive hypothesis testing
summary: We study binary hypothesis testing for i.i.d. observations under a multiplicative context weight. For the optimal weighted total loss, defined as the sum of weighted type-I and type-II losses, we prove the logarithmic asymptotic $$ L_n^* = \exp\{-n D_C^{\mathrm{w}}(\mathbb{P}, \mathbb{Q}) + o(n)\}, \quad n \to \infty, $$ where $D_C^{\mathrm{w}}$ is the weighted Chernoff information.
